backend/main.mo: Defines an empty Motoko actor with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Structured report mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs with high-confidence annotations.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists concise summaries for major frontend components, pages, styles, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/style variables defining light/dark OKLCH theme tokens and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app root and main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, meta tag updates, and global layout rendering.
frontend/src/components/CinematicBackgro: Canvas-based animated background with DPR-aware sizing, particles, gradients, and reduced-motion fallback.
Renders a grid of animated flip-card feature items with icons and glow effects.
frontend/src/components/FinalCTA.tsx: Final call‑to‑action section with radial glow background, headline, and buttons for join, WhatsApp, and call actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, quick links, contact details, and a branded credit section.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the homepage hero with branding, description, and CTA buttons including scrolling and WhatsApp links.
Shows contact details, address, and an embedded Google Maps iframe with a directions CTA.
Lists key fitness services in a grid with icons and includes a CTA linking to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Implements the sticky site header with navigation links, active states, and a mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/StickyButtons.ts: Adds floating WhatsApp and call buttons fixed to screen corners for quick contact.
frontend/src/components/TransformationSe: Presents transformation benefits with icons and a CTA, along with a placeholder visual card.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeSection.t: Introduces the academy with a welcome message, description, and a call-now button.
frontend/src/components/WhyChooseUs.tsx: A React component that displays a styled grid of reasons to choose the service and includes a call-to-action phone button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and manages a backend actor instance using the current Internet Identity and react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend queries are needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with custom theme variables, utility classes, and animations for the app's design system.
frontend/src/layouts/SiteLayout.tsx: Defines the main site layout with header, footer, background, sticky buttons, and routed content.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that initializes React, wraps the app with query and identity providers, and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with hero section, story content, and values highlighting the fitness academy’s mission.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Renders the Contact page with hero section, contact methods, and location/timing details.
frontend/src/pages/CoursesPage.tsx: Renders the Courses page with a hero section and a list of course offerings, each containing details like features, benefits, and schedule info.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Composes the homepage by assembling multiple section components such as hero, welcome, services, features, location, and final CTA.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Displays a styled 404 page with navigation options to return home or go back, using gradient backgrounds and UI components.
frontend/src/seo/pageMeta.ts: Defines SEO metadata (title, description, keywords) for key site routes in a structured object.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, container settings, and additional plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, known issues, and feature requests related to fixing and improving the cinematic background system.
